newsitem.title: POLAND: HSBC JAMES CAPEL GIVES BPH "BUY" RATING.
newsitem.headline: HSBC JAMES CAPEL GIVES BPH "BUY" RATING.

text.p: Investors should buy shares of Poland's Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy SA (BPH), which has been agressively raising its market share by building up deposits and increasing consumer lending, HSBC James Capel said.

"The company is well advanced in its automation plans and our valuation work suggests an end 1997 target value per share of 234 zlotys plus dividend of five zlotys. At the current price of 200 zlotys, BPH is a buy," the report said.
The report on Central Europe in 1997 dated February 3 said BPH would likely continue to grow profits despite a squeeze on interest margins as inflation declines.
BPH closed at 198 zlotys on the Warsaw bourse on Tuesday.
HSBC James Capel also maintained its buy recommendation for Elektrim , which it saw creating a tighter management structure.
It kept its hold rating for BFK , which despite strong earnings growth it saw needing an ever expanding investment programme to maintain the momentum.
